name: damlevels-data
title: DamLevels-Data: daily storage of Tunisia's 36 large dams, 2014-2025
description: Provenance-traced daily storage observations, qualified inter-dam transfer facts, dam metadata, QA results and GIS layers reconstructed from the DGBGTH bulletins published by ONAGRI. Current quality indicators: qa/kpi/results.

resources.name: storage
resources.description: Primary Page 1 storage observations only; exactly one intended record per governed dam/date.

resources.name: transfers
resources.description: Page 3 inter-dam transfer and Sejnane accounting facts, authority PROBABLE. Time semantics: in all rows date = bulletin_date (the bulletin date D) and effective_date_rule = SAME_DAY, as recorded by the selected Page 3 product. This conflicts with the DamLevels ontology (DLO 0.3): the 'today' amount is the amount over day D-1 (DAY_BEFORE_BULLETIN), and current_season_to_date / previous_season_to_date are cumulative totals from 1 September up to day D-1 (SEASON_TO_DATE), not daily amounts. The published fields are kept as printed; see docs/known_issues.md.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date as stored by the selected Page 3 product: equal to bulletin_date (the bulletin date D) in all rows, with effective_date_rule SAME_DAY. It is not the day the amount refers to: under DLO 0.3 'today' is the amount over day D-1 and season-to-date measures are totals from 1 September up to day D-1.

fields.name: effective_date_rule
fields.description: Date rule recorded by the selected product (SAME_DAY in all rows; conflicts with DLO 0.3, see the resource description).

fields.name: from_dam_id
fields.description: Confirmed stable source dam ID; blank if unproven/not applicable.

fields.name: to_dam_id
fields.description: Confirmed stable destination dam ID; blank if unproven/not applicable.

fields.name: variable
fields.description: Reported Page 3 measure: today (amount over day D-1), current_season_to_date or previous_season_to_date (cumulative totals up to day D-1, not daily amounts).

fields.name: value
fields.description: Reported value; blank states remain blank.

resources.name: bulletin-page1

fields.name: source_row_key
fields.description: Row key PAGE_1|bulletin_date|dam_id; equals source_row_key in data/storage.csv.

fields.name: bulletin_date
fields.description: Bulletin date D as printed. Each value column states which day it describes; dates are not shifted.

fields.name: source_sha256
fields.description: Source Page 1 PDF SHA-256; equals page1_sha256 in sources/manifest.csv.

fields.name: layout
fields.description: Page 1 layout: P1_LAYOUT_16_WITH_FILL (fill column printed, from 2019-02-05) or P1_LAYOUT_15_NO_FILL.

fields.name: authority_release
fields.description: Extraction authority: PAGE1_0.2.3_CURRENT_EXTRACTION_DELIVERY, the same as data/storage.csv.

fields.name: p1_apport_today
fields.description: Inflow over day D-1 (the day before the bulletin), Mm3. Six negative printed values are kept as printed.

fields.name: p1_apport_cumul_this_month
fields.description: Inflow month to date through day D-1, Mm3; restarts on the bulletin of the 2nd.

fields.name: p1_apport_average_month
fields.description: Long-term mean inflow of the month, Mm3 (a reference, not an observation of this year).

fields.name: p1_apport_cumul_since_sep
fields.description: Inflow season to date, 1 September through day D-1, Mm3; restarts on the bulletin of 2 September.

fields.name: p1_apport_cumul_prev_year
fields.description: Inflow over the same season-to-date period one year earlier, Mm3.

fields.name: p1_apport_average_period
fields.description: Long-term mean inflow of the season-to-date period, Mm3 (a reference).

fields.name: p1_release_action_code
fields.description: Operation codes printed beside the releases, comma-separated as printed (E, p, tr, T, d, ...). No printed legend was found: meanings are provisional.

fields.name: p1_release_yesterday
fields.description: Release over day D-1 (the day before the bulletin), Mm3. This is the current release.

fields.name: p1_release_today
fields.description: Release on the same day one year earlier, Mm3 (second value under 'Lachers du jour'). Never the current release.

fields.name: p1_release_cumul_this_month
fields.description: Release month to date through day D-1, Mm3; restarts on the bulletin of the 2nd.

fields.name: p1_release_cumul_year
fields.description: Release season to date, 1 September through day D-1, Mm3; restarts on the bulletin of 2 September.

fields.name: p1_release_cumul_last_year
fields.description: Release over the same season-to-date period one year earlier, Mm3.

fields.name: p1_stock_fill_pct
fields.description: Printed fill, percent of useful capacity, state on day D. Printed from 2019-02-05 only; equals qa/printed_fill_reference.csv.

fields.name: p1_stock_today_mm3
fields.description: Storage, state on day D, Mm3; equals value in data/storage.csv.

fields.name: p1_stock_last_year_mm3
fields.description: Storage on the same date one year earlier, Mm3.
